Source counter vs rows seen: counter says 3737 total shipments / 14 trading partners / 49 ports; only 5 shipment rows and 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows were visible in the free view, so the 3737 figure is the site's own counter and was not independently row-verified. Domestic (India) supply evidence remains unverified — no GST or tender record obtained; do not treat as confirmed.
